# Wolven Tech

> Wolven Tech is a UK Rust technical advisory and software development practice operated by WOLVEN TECH ADVISORY LTD, company 16811183. It builds Rust systems and publishes separate software products.

## Scope

- Wolven Tech is the operator, not the name of each product it builds.
- Services include Rust architecture, technical due diligence, platform work, and advisory; current scope and terms are described on the website.
- Product features, prices, availability, and policies belong to each linked product's own domain.
- Case-study figures on the site describe specific work and should not be treated as guaranteed outcomes.
